t: You're on Henrietta Place, in Marylebone. It runs from Marylebone Lane in the east to Cavendish Square in the west, and it was originally called Henrietta Street. Welbeck Street and Wimpole Street join it on the north side, and Vere Street, Chapel Place and Old Cavendish Street on the south. The name comes from Henrietta Harley, Countess of Oxford and Countess Mortimer, who lived from 1694 to 1755. She was the only child and heiress of John Holles, 1st Duke of Newcastle.
